meaning.en: Om, salutations to Shiva
to the teacher
to the one whose very form is being, awareness, and bliss
to the one beyond all phenomena, beyond the unfolding show of the world
to the peaceful one
to the one who needs no support, unpropped
meaning.hi: निरालम्ब को, बिना सहारे वाले को

meaning.en: to the radiant one, the one who shines with his own light

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: taking shelter in the unsupported truth
one who abandons every prop
meaning.hi: जो हर सहारे को त्याग देता है

meaning.en: he is both a true renunciant and a true yogi
meaning.hi: वह संन्यासी भी है और योगी भी

meaning.en: attains the state of final oneness, absolute freedom
meaning.hi: कैवल्य पद को प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: of creatures caught in ignorance
for the calming of all their afflictions
meaning.hi: समस्त कष्टों की शांति के लिए

meaning.en: whatever needs to be known, in its entirety
meaning.hi: जो कुछ भी जानने योग्य है, संपूर्णतः

meaning.en: that, without doubt, I shall now explain
meaning.hi: उसे मैं अब निःसंदेह समझाता हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: what is Brahman
who is the Lord
what is the individual self
what is nature
who is the Supreme Self
what is caste
what is action, what is inaction
meaning.hi: कर्म क्या है, अकर्म क्या है

meaning.en: what is knowledge, what is ignorance
meaning.hi: ज्ञान क्या है, अज्ञान क्या है

meaning.en: what is bondage, what is liberation
meaning.hi: बंधन क्या है, मोक्ष क्या है

meaning.en: who is a true renunciant
thus it was said in reply
filling the vast shell of the universe, like a yolk filling an egg
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मांड के विशाल कोश को अंडे की जर्दी की तरह भरते हुए

meaning.en: without beginning or end, pure, gentle, peaceful, beyond all describable qualities

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Brahman, relying on its own power called nature
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म अपनी प्रकृति नामक शक्ति के सहारे

meaning.en: creating the worlds, entering them as the inner guide
meaning.hi: लोकों की रचना कर, अंतर्यामी रूप में उनमें प्रवेश कर

meaning.en: and regarding the individual self
through the false imposition of identity, one becomes an individual self
meaning.hi: मिथ्या अध्यास के कारण जीव बनता है

meaning.en: and regarding caste

words.sanskrit: na charmano na raktasya na mamsasya na cha asthinah

meaning.en: caste belongs neither to skin, blood, flesh, nor bone
meaning.hi: न त्वचा की, न रक्त की, न मांस की, न हड्डी की जाति होती है

meaning.en: and regarding action
the felt sense 'I am doing this'
and regarding knowledge: the direct, realized experience
meaning.hi: और ज्ञान के विषय में: प्रत्यक्ष साक्षात्कार का अनुभव

words.sanskrit: ajnanam iti cha rajjau sarpa-bhrantih iva

meaning.en: and regarding ignorance: like mistaking a rope for a snake
meaning.hi: और अज्ञान के विषय में: जैसे रस्सी में साँप का भ्रम

meaning.en: and regarding happiness: knowing one's own being-awareness-bliss nature
meaning.hi: और सुख के विषय में: अपने सच्चिदानंद स्वरूप को जानना

meaning.en: and regarding heaven: the company of the good and wise
meaning.hi: और स्वर्ग के विषय में: सज्जनों की संगति

meaning.en: and regarding hell: the company of the unwise
meaning.hi: और नरक के विषय में: दुर्जनों की संगति

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
